title: Diana Ross & The Supremes Greatest Hits 8-Track Tape, Motown
descriptionText:
The Diana Ross And The Supremes Greatest Hits 8-Track Tape features classic Motown hits from the 1970s era. This vintage Motown Record Corp 8-track cartridge showcases the soulful music of Diana Ross and The Supremes, with tracks that have stood the test of time.
Condition: This cartridge has a hole punched through the case front-to-back (see photo), most likely from being mounted for wall display — playback is not guaranteed as a result. The paper label is also torn/worn in spots. Selling as-is for parts, repair, or display/decor use. No returns accepted, so please review the photo closely before buying.
